title: feat(cluster): settings changes reach every replica (settings lane) (#3814 F3b)
body:
epic:#3814#1 · os-zhuang · session_01QUs3BrVu5TqwtmuhsjdEvM
Filing gate: ③ maintainer-dispatched task (child of #3814). Maintainer, (2026-11-08, 16:25 UTC): 「继续，现在派第二批」 (gate 1 after the card 0 inventory, cloud#3868 comment 6723322368).

Parent: #3814 (rulings R0-R6 on comment 6722625146).

## Problem (smoke, card 0)
`settings:changed` is an in-process Set (`settings-service.ts:1304/1320`). Its subscribers rebuild the auth posture, password/session/MFA policy, org access policy, mail, SMS, storage adapter and AI provider. Under round-robin only the writing replica rebuilds: r1 set `require_email_verification=true` and refused sign-in, while **r2 still answered 200 after 95 s**. Peers keep the old configuration until restart, including security posture.

## Do
1. A fifth cluster lane (beside the four in `metadata-cluster-bridge-plugin.ts`): broadcast the changed namespace/key; receivers re-read the settings store and emit their local `settings:changed`, so every subscriber rebuilds from the DB (the DB stays the source of truth; the message carries no values or secrets).
2. Join the F3a reconnect resync (re-read all namespaces) once F3a lands; if F3a is not merged yet, leave a clearly named hook.
3. Tests: two kernels on a shared pubsub: a settings write on A changes B's auth posture within one second; single node emits exactly what it emits today.

## Rules that bind every #3814 child (verbatim rulings on the parent)
R1 peer round-robin. R2 Redis required for multi-replica only. R3 「同意：每张卡都只在"声明多副本并接上 Redis 驱动"时才生效」: the single-node default path is unchanged, multi-replica behaviour switches on only behind declared replicas>1 AND a connected Redis cluster driver, the split-brain guard is never weakened, and the deploy README "multi-node unsupported" line stays until the final gate.

## Done when
PR merged; a settings change on one replica is effective on every replica within seconds; single node unchanged.
